branch_protocol.candidate_seed_derivation: HMAC-SHA256(master_seed, canonical JSON of domain, rollout_id, target_id, purpose=candidate_action, action_slot), first 8 bytes big-endian masked to 63 bits.
branch_protocol.composition: One exactly recorded action plus three direct single-sample candidates.
branch_protocol.deterministic_scorer: Verbatim span precision/recall/F1 bytes bound by the frozen evaluator program and source references.
branch_protocol.topology_divergence: Recorded as an ordinary deterministic branch outcome under the frozen event-replay finalizer; never repaired or resampled.

cpu_hardening.watchdog: Every retry layer has zero retries; a deterministic observer failure is a non-retryable 409 and all sibling work is cancelled and awaited within two seconds.

interpretation_and_disposition.branchability_or_informativeness_failure: End the current Stage D design as a natural-workflow feasibility negative without threshold or task tuning.
interpretation_and_disposition.scaffold_first_failure: Report an initialization-associated shortfall descriptively; no automatic SFT, prompt, threshold, selector, or task change is authorized.
interpretation_and_disposition.support_fail: End this Stage D support design and preserve the systems and CPU results; no automatic successor.
interpretation_and_disposition.support_pass: Authorize only artifact recovery, reporting, and design of a separately preregistered and independently reviewed scientific campaign. No scientific arm runs on this pod.

mandatory_failfast_assertions: coalesced waiters receive the original error
different-operation sibling and root work is cancelled and awaited within two seconds
one subsequent pristine structural address starts normally

purpose: Measure the natural eligible-and-informative branch-target density of the unchanged Stage D scaffold policy after closure-based observer hardening.

repair_and_attempt_policy.after_any_response_bytes: No automatic redeployment. Recover evidence, retire every observed address, report an incomplete campaign, and require a separately reviewed preregistration for any environment-only successor.
repair_and_attempt_policy.novel_finish_reason_or_schema: Terminal invariant, never retrospectively added to the frozen action closure.
repair_and_attempt_policy.second_provisioning_attempt_allowed_only: The first pod fails for demonstrated infrastructure reasons before any provider POST or model response bytes; the exact same untouched cohort and hashes are reused.

resource_guardrails.abort_behavior: Stop scheduling new work at the first wall, billing, call, token, or wallet-reserve ceiling; recover evidence and classify the campaign incomplete, never as support failure.
resource_guardrails.hardware: Exactly one non-spot 2x48GB L40, L40S, or RTX 6000 Ada resource at no more than $2.00/hour; never A100/H100.
resource_guardrails.mandatory_teardown: Recover compact artifacts, terminate compute, and confirm zero persistent disks on every terminal path.

support_rule.N_eligible: N_scaffold and both frozen targets were pre-action committed with exact source topology, restorability, replayability, and total outer weight one.
support_rule.N_joint: N_eligible and at least one of the two K=4 target groups has reward-F1 range at least 0.05.
support_rule.N_scaffold: Both predeclared first-turn children were produced.
support_rule.first_failed_gate: Descriptive only; it does not establish that later mechanisms passed when their conditional denominator is small.
support_rule.infrastructure_or_invariant_loss: Incomplete campaign with no support conclusion.
reporting: fixed 95% Wilson intervals with exact denominators

target_selection.commitment_timing: Each target is committed before its source action is reserved and before any reward, reference answer, or realized model output is inspected.
target_selection.natural_extra_topology: Well-formed additional topology is handled only by the frozen finalizer and may make the source denominator-negative.
target_selection.replacement_forbidden: Extra children, later turns, reward-bearing calls, and apparently promising calls never replace either frozen target.

user_authorization.statement: Run the bounded CPU hardening, freeze a fresh support protocol, and proceed on Prime after independent review.
